section: Public distribution, procurement and buffer-stocking; food subsidy and FCI reform
subsections: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)

accepted.s:
Which one of the following correctly represents the sequence of major developments in India's Public Distribution System?
A. PDS — RPDS — TPDS — AAY
B. RPDS — PDS — AAY — TPDS
C. PDS — TPDS — RPDS — AAY
D. AAY — RPDS — TPDS — PDS
accepted.x: The sequence was PDS, followed by RPDS in June 1992, TPDS in June 1997 and AAY on 25 December 2000.
accepted.tq: Use the first-and-last items to eliminate reversed sequences.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Public Distribution System in India first began in the 1940s primarily in the context of which event?
o: The introduction of the National Food Security Act
accepted.x: Rationing began in the 1940s against the backdrop of the Bengal famine. The system was later revived during the food shortages of the 1960s.
accepted.tq: Identify the historical context associated with the origin of the policy.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Revamped Public Distribution System (RPDS):
1. It was launched in June 1992.
2. It focused on backward, hilly and drought-prone areas.
3. It introduced separate entitlements for BPL and APL households.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: RPDS was launched in June 1992 for backward, hilly and drought areas. Separate BPL and APL entitlements were introduced later under TPDS.
accepted.tq: Split the statements by matching each feature with the correct reform stage.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS), introduced in June 1997, was characterised by which of the following?
o: Separate entitlements for BPL and APL households
Conversion of all fair price shops into mini-marts
accepted.x: TPDS introduced separate entitlements for Below Poverty Line and Above Poverty Line households in June 1997.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the defining feature of a policy from features of later reforms.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) was launched on 25 December 2000 to provide how much foodgrain per family per month to the poorest households?
accepted.x: AAY was launched on 25 December 2000 for the poorest households, with an entitlement of 35 kg of foodgrain per family per month.
accepted.tq: Use the exact date and quantity rather than confusing AAY with other food entitlements.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Food Security Act, 2013, provided a legal entitlement to foodgrain for approximately how many people?
accepted.x: The National Food Security Act, 2013, gave a legal food entitlement to about 800 million people.
accepted.tq: Test the scale of coverage through the exact approximate figure.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY), NFSA foodgrains were made free from:
accepted.x: NFSA grain was made free under PMGKAY from 1 January 2023.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely spaced implementation dates.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The High Level Committee headed by Shanta Kumar estimated PDS leakage at approximately what level, using NSSO 2011–12 data?
accepted.x: The Shanta Kumar High Level Committee estimated PDS leakage at about 46 per cent based on NSSO 2011–12 data.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact percentage associated with the committee estimate.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a reform measure associated with improving the functioning of the Public Distribution System?
o: Replacement of all foodgrain distribution by export subsidies
Installation of electronic Point of Sale devices at Fair Price Shops
accepted.x: ePoS, Aadhaar seeding and portability are PDS reforms. Replacement of domestic foodgrain distribution by export subsidies is not a stated PDS reform.
accepted.tq: Find the option that belongs to an unrelated policy objective.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in the PDS refers to:
o: Distribution of foodgrain only through biometric machines
Payment of procurement prices directly to Fair Price Shops
Payment of food subsidy in cash instead of supplying foodgrain
Transfer of foodgrain from one State to another without payment
accepted.x: DBT in the food sector means that the subsidy is transferred in cash instead of being provided through physical grain distribution.
accepted.tq: Separate the meaning of cash transfer from authentication and physical distribution reforms.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
DBT in food under the NFSA is implemented in which of the following areas?
1. Chandigarh
2. Puducherry
3. Urban Dadra and Nagar Haveli
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: NFSA food subsidy is paid in cash in Chandigarh, Puducherry and urban Dadra and Nagar Haveli.
accepted.tq: Check every location in a compact list before selecting the combined option.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Shanta Kumar Committee recommended cash transfers in the PDS particularly for areas that are:
accepted.x: The Committee recommended cash transfers in well-connected areas, where beneficiaries can more readily access markets and financial services.
accepted.tq: Apply the recommendation to the condition specified for its use.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)?
o: It replaces Aadhaar-seeded ration cards with paper coupons.
It restricts beneficiaries to the Fair Price Shop linked to their permanent residence.
It permits ration portability only within the district of issue.
It permits ration portability anywhere in the country through ePoS-enabled Fair Price Shops.
accepted.x: ONORC enables beneficiaries to obtain ration anywhere in the country through ePoS devices at Fair Price Shops.
accepted.tq: Test the practical consequence of portability against restrictive location-based alternatives.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which set of technologies and identifiers is associated with authentication under ONORC?
o: PAN-linked ration cards with signature authentication only
Aadhaar-seeded ration cards with fingerprint or iris authentication
Passport-linked ration cards with face authentication only
Voter-ID cards with voice authentication only
accepted.x: ONORC uses Aadhaar-seeded ration cards and fingerprint or iris authentication through ePoS devices.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme with its exact authentication mechanism rather than a related identity document.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The mobile application associated with One Nation One Ration Card is:
accepted.x: The mobile application associated with ONORC is named “Mera Ration”.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact official name of the scheme-linked application.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The nationwide rollout target for One Nation One Ration Card was 1 June of which year?
accepted.x: The nationwide rollout target for ONORC was 1 June 2020.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the target year from the year in which the portability reform was initiated.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the reported status of ONORC infrastructure and usage?
o: More than 3.07 billion portability transactions and 99.8% of Fair Price Shops automated
More than 2.07 billion portability transactions and 79.8% of Fair Price Shops automated
More than 1.07 billion portability transactions and 89.8% of Fair Price Shops automated
More than 2.07 billion portability transactions and 99.8% of Fair Price Shops automated for Aadhaar-based distribution
accepted.x: The reported figures were over 2.07 billion portability transactions and 99.8 per cent of Fair Price Shops automated for Aadhaar-based distribution.
accepted.tq: Match two quantitative indicators in the same factual statement.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following was a component of End-to-End Computerisation of TPDS?
1. Digitisation of ration cards
2. Online allocation
3. Supply-chain computerisation
4. ePoS
Select the correct answer using the code given below.

accepted.s: Integrated Management of PDS (IM-PDS), introduced from April 2018, is principally associated with:
o: Conversion of Fair Price Shops into mini-marts

accepted.tq: Associate a reform name with its principal operational function.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the four modules of SMART-PDS?
o: Ration card and Fair Price Shop management
accepted.x: SMART-PDS has modules covering procurement, supply chain and allocation, ration card and FPS management, and biometric eKYC distribution. International trade and export promotion is not one of its modules.
accepted.tq: Find the unrelated administrative function among the scheme modules.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about SARTHAK-PDS:
1. It is an umbrella scheme that includes SMART-PDS.
2. It provides for intra-state movement and Fair Price Shop dealer margins.
3. It proposes the use of AI/ML, blockchain and NLP for monitoring and grievance redressal.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: SARTHAK-PDS is an umbrella scheme covering SMART-PDS, intra-state movement and FPS dealer margins, with AI/ML, blockchain and NLP proposed for monitoring and grievances.
accepted.tq: Test whether the listed functions form the complete umbrella-scheme design.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: SARTHAK-PDS is an abbreviation for:
o: Scheme for Assistance in Ration Transport and Handling-Income with Automation in PDS
System for Allocation of Ration Transport and Household Assistance through Digital PDS
Scheme for Automated Ration Trade and Handling with Aadhaar Tracking in Public Distribution
Special Assistance for Ration and Transport Handling through Automated Community Distribution
accepted.x: SARTHAK-PDS expands to “Scheme for Assistance in Ration Transport and Handling-Income with Automation in PDS”.
accepted.tq: Test the exact expansion of an official programme acronym.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is the principal content of the SMART-PDS scheme for April 2023–March 2026?
o: Four modules covering procurement, supply chain and allocation, ration card and FPS management, and biometric eKYC distribution
Only cash transfers and export subsidies for NFSA beneficiaries
Four modules covering rural roads, irrigation, fertiliser distribution and crop insurance
Only construction of warehouses and procurement of oilseeds
accepted.x: SMART-PDS consists of four modules: procurement; supply chain and allocation; ration card and FPS management; and biometric eKYC distribution.
accepted.tq: Choose the option that accurately preserves the complete scheme architecture.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly describes the Andhra Pradesh e-PDS position given below?
1. It has 1.44 crore rice cards.
2. All the rice cards are Aadhaar-seeded.
3. It has 29,783 Fair Price Shops serving 4.3 crore people.
4. It supports biometric transactions with in-State portability.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh e-PDS system has 1.44 crore rice cards, 100 per cent Aadhaar seeding, 29,783 FPS serving 4.3 crore people, and biometric transactions with in-State portability.
accepted.tq: Use the all-inclusive option after verifying each administrative and numerical detail.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Mee Mart, introduced in Andhra Pradesh in July 2026, is intended to:
o: Provide only free rice through mobile ration vans
Replace Fair Price Shops with warehouses selling only imported foodgrains
Convert ration cards into cash-credit cards for farmers
Convert Fair Price Shops into mini-marts selling more than 250 items at prices ₹3–5 below the market price
accepted.x: Mee Mart converts FPSs into mini-marts selling over 250 items at ₹3–5 below market prices. The initiative is run with NCCF.
accepted.tq: Identify the operational purpose and price advantage of the State-specific reform.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:

2. 553 outlets were ready.

accepted.x: Mee Mart planned 1,000 outlets, had 553 ready, opened its first outlet at Lalupuram near Guntur, and was being run with NCCF.
accepted.tq: Verify the location, implementing partner and two numerical targets together.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]

o: Zinc, vitamin D and vitamin K
Iron, vitamin B12 and folic acid
accepted.x: PDS-supplied fortified rice contains iron, vitamin B12 and folic acid and is intended to combat micronutrient deficiency.

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): One Nation One Ration Card enables beneficiaries to obtain ration away from the place where their ration card was originally issued.
Reason (R): ONORC uses ePoS devices, Aadhaar-seeded ration cards and biometric authentication at Fair Price Shops.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both statements are true, and the ePoS-based, Aadhaar-seeded and biometric system enables ration portability under ONORC.
accepted.tq: Check whether the authentication infrastructure directly explains the portability claim.
accepted.sec: TPDS evolution - PDS, RPDS, TPDS, AAY (launch sequence), leakage estimates, reforms (ePoS, Aadhaar seeding, DBT)  [APPSC]
